notes.title: [Release Notes] 1.0.1 : Fixed standing animation, updated game engine
notes.content:
* Fixed lip-sync to work during standing animation.
* The game engine has been updated to improve stability during and after movie playback (r3065 -> r3106)

notes.title: End of distribution of external update files and price reductions
notes.content:
Distribution of external update files for this title will end at 23:59 JST March 31, 2023.
There are no plans for redistribution at this time.
If you have not yet downloaded the file, please download it as soon as possible.

We also plan to reduce the price in accordance with the above actions.

The title of the same series, >, is also scheduled to be updated (with the end of external update file distribution and price reduction). If you haven't played it yet, please do so!
